verdict.rationale: Skyvern's debugging docs say every run automatically captures session recordings, per-step screenshots, the AI's reasoning and network traffic. They also describe diagnosing failed runs from status, failure category, recording and logs. A community user independently praises the step-level observability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a step-by-step action timeline view (only implied by per-step screenshots and reasoning), and in-depth or hands-on corroboration of the replay debugging workflow itself.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: Every run automatically captures what happened: recordings of the browser session, screenshots at each step, the AI's reasoning, and network traffic.
Find out why a run failed or returned the wrong result, from its status, failure category, recording and logs, and fix it.
I especially like the observability around the workflow and the steps it takes to achieve the outcome.
